name: mittwald Provider
description: This enables the use of mittwald for the AI module.
project_description: Integrates mittwald AI Hosting with the Drupal AI module, letting a site run AI operations on mittwald's OpenAI-compatible LLM platform (default endpoint llm.aihosting.mittwald.de/v1). The provider supports chat, embeddings, rerank, speech-to-text and text-to-speech; moderation and text-to-image are declared but not implemented. Because mittwald does not report model capabilities, the module hard-codes model filtering by operation type (regex on model ids) and derives reasoning/vision handling heuristically. The API key is held through the Key module and sent as a bearer token; on save the module validates the key by listing models and warns if the account is on a rate-limited free/quota tier. Default models (e.g. Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512 for chat, Qwen3-Embedding-8B for embeddings) are seeded automatically.
